identificationModule.briefTitle: A Study of MRG002 in Treatment of Advanced HER-2 Positive Breast Cancer Patients
identificationModule.officialTitle: An Open-label, Multi-center, Single-arm Phase II Clinical Study to Evaluate the Efficacy and Safety of MRG002 in Advanced HER-2 Positive Breast Cancer Patients Previously Treated With Trastuzumab and TKIs (Magic-009)

descriptionModule.briefSummary: The objective of this study is to assess the safety, efficacy, pharmacokinetics, and immunogenicity of MRG002 in patients with HER2 positive breast cancer with liver metastases.

armGroups.label: MRG002
armGroups.description: MRG002 will be administrated via intravenous infusion of 2.6 mg/kg once on Day 1 of every 3 weeks (21-day cycle).

primaryOutcomes.measure: Objective Response Rate (ORR) by Independent Review Committee (IRC)
primaryOutcomes.description: ORR is defined as the proportion of subjects with complete response (CR) and partial response (PR) assessed by IRC according to RECIST v1.1.
primaryOutcomes.timeFrame: Baseline to study completion (up to 12 months）

secondaryOutcomes.description: ORR is defined as the proportion of subjects with CR and PR assessed by investigator according to RECIST v1.1.
secondaryOutcomes.timeFrame: Baseline to study completion (up to 12 months)

secondaryOutcomes.description: DOR is defined as the duration from the initial recording of objective disease response to the first onset of tumor progression, or death of any cause.
secondaryOutcomes.timeFrame: Baseline to study completion (up to 12 months)

secondaryOutcomes.description: CBR is defined as the proportion of subjects with CR, PR and stable disease (SD) ≥ 6 months after treatment.
secondaryOutcomes.timeFrame: Baseline to study completion (up to 12 months)

secondaryOutcomes.description: TTR is defined as the time from the start of treatment until the first occurrence of CR or PR by tumor assessment.
secondaryOutcomes.timeFrame: Baseline to study completion (up to 12 months)

secondaryOutcomes.description: DCR is defined as the proportion of subjects achieving CR, PR, and stable disease (SD) after treatment.
secondaryOutcomes.timeFrame: Baseline to study completion (up to 12 months)

secondaryOutcomes.description: PFS is defined as the duration from the start of treatment to the onset of tumor progression or death of any cause.
secondaryOutcomes.timeFrame: Baseline to study completion (up to 12 months)

secondaryOutcomes.description: OS is defined as the duration from the start of treatment to death of any cause.
